payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?

access.q: How do I access the course?
access.a: By card, access opens as soon as the payment is confirmed; with the other payment methods, as soon as we have checked the receipt. It is for life, on your phone, tablet or computer.

abroad.q: Can I follow the course from outside Spain?
abroad.a: Yes. Everything is online, with lifetime access on phone, tablet or computer: you follow the course wherever you live. The rules, procedures and authorities covered are Spain's, where the development takes place.

invoice.a: Yes, an invoice can be issued on request after payment. Write to us with your order reference.

support.a: Our team answers by email and by phone or WhatsApp during office hours, and helps you with any technical issue.

modules.q: Do I have to buy everything at once?
modules.a: No. Modules are sold one by one, depending on where you are. Discounts grow with the number of modules, and full access remains the cheapest option per module.

projectType.q: Does it suit my type of project?
projectType.a: The course follows an open-market housing development, from the plot to after-sales. Much of the journey — land, permits, financing, construction, legalisation — is the same for commercial and mixed-use schemes. Subsidised housing adds requirements set by each region that are not covered in detail.

whatIs.q: What is a real estate development course and what will I learn?
whatIs.a: It is training that explains how to develop housing from start to finish. In CONSTRUYE you go through the 12 phases: plot, feasibility, design, licences, financing, construction, sales, legalisation, handover and after-sales.

needExperience.q: Do I need experience, a degree or a lot of capital to be a property developer?
needExperience.a: The law does not require any particular qualification to be a developer. The capital you need depends on each project: the financing module and the financial model teach you to work it out before you commit.

stepByStep.q: How is a housing development done, step by step?
stepByStep.a: You start with the plot and its planning analysis, work out the feasibility, commission the design, apply for the licences, finance and build. Then you sell, legalise the works, hand over the keys and look after after-sales. The course develops each step.

anyProvince.q: Is the course valid for any province in Spain?
anyProvince.a: Yes. It includes the state rules, a directory of partners for all 52 provinces and an annex with the tax and planning rules of each autonomous community.

financials.q: What is the Financials financial model?
financials.a: It is a professional's spreadsheet that calculates the total cost of a development and the financing it needs. It has 17 sheets, more than 30,000 formulas and a worked example. In the course you learn to fill it in and read it, and the platform calculates it with your figures.

roles.q: What is the difference between a developer, a builder and an estate agent?
roles.a: The developer decides on, drives and finances the works and is liable to the buyer. The builder carries them out and the agent sells. In a small development one person can take on several roles, and the course explains the responsibilities of each.

company.q: Can I develop through a limited company?
company.a: Yes, it is the usual way to develop. Since Ley 18/2022 an S.L. can be set up with a capital of 1 euro, under conditions. The course explains how to set up the development company.

opportunity.title: Every year more households are formed than homes are built. That gap is your opportunity
opportunity.lead: Spain is short of homes, prices are rising and the State has approved a 7,000 million euro plan to boost supply. Whoever knows how to develop has in front of them the market with the most unmet demand in years.
opportunity.d1Label: New households a year in 2026 (structural demand)
opportunity.d3Label: Annual gap between demand and homes started
opportunity.d8Note: at least 40% for building and buying homes
opportunity.caveat: Shortfall estimates vary with the body and the method (the Banco de España, BBVA Research and CaixaBank Research do not agree on the exact figure), but they all point the same way.
opportunity.m1Body: It is not a forecast: every year some 223,000 households are formed and 153,000 homes are started.
opportunity.m2Body: From 139,000 homes started in 2025 to 153,000 in 2026 (+10%), and 170,000 forecast for 2027.
opportunity.m3Body: The state plan prioritises new building and industrialised construction, and homes built with its funds will be permanently protected.
opportunity.m4Body: With land and costs rising, the margin is won in the feasibility study. Whoever buys a plot without running the numbers loses. That is why CONSTRUYE starts with the plot and the profit and loss account.
opportunity.cta: See how a development is done, phase by phase

programme.title: From the plot to after-sales: the {{phases}} phases of a development, explained step by step
programme.lead: Each module tells you what to do, in what order, who to go to and which law applies. With practical checklists, a quiz per module and a final exam.
programme.p1: Find plots, read the planning rules and buy with no legal or planning surprises
programme.p2: Work out cost, financing and margin before committing a single euro
programme.p3: Hire and coordinate the architect, the engineers and the site supervision team
programme.p4: Know which licence to apply for, to whom, and what administrative silence means
programme.p5: Set up the development loan, the guarantees and the construction contract
programme.p6: Organise the works, the deadlines and the compulsory insurance
programme.p7: Keep watch on valuations, quality and cost overruns
programme.p8: Set the price and sell off-plan with the guarantees the law requires
programme.p9: Close out completion, the new building declaration, the horizontal division and habitability
programme.p10: Inspect the home with the buyer and fix things before handing over
programme.p11: Hand over with the paperwork in order and without disputes
programme.p12: Handle warranties and claims, and close the development financially

difference.title: Three things that make the difference
difference.financialsTitle: Financials: a professional's financial model, inside the course
difference.financialsBody: Nine lessons and a model of 17 sheets with more than 30,000 formulas that calculates the total cost of a development: land, construction, external works, design, licences, financing and management. It is used exactly as the professional designed it, with their real worked example, so you can see how a development comes out before risking money.
difference.partnersBody: For each phase, a directory of the bodies and professionals you will work with in your province. You do not start from scratch when you walk into a new town hall.
difference.lawsBody: The state rules (the Land Act, the Building Act or LOE, the Building Code or CTE) and an annex with the tax and planning rules of each autonomous community, so what you learn holds in Alicante, in Madrid or in Seville.
difference.extra1: Downloads to work with: the financial model in Excel (full and simplified), the partners directory in Excel and the whole course in PDF.
difference.extra2: A checklist per module, to tick off on your own project and keep in your account.
difference.extra3: Quizzes per module and a final exam to check you have taken it in.

forWhom.title: Is CONSTRUYE for you?
forWhom.yes1: You want to do your first development and do not know where to start.
forWhom.yes2: You are an architect, builder, estate agent or investor and want to make the leap to developer.
forWhom.yes3: You have a plot or an opportunity and need to know whether it pays off.
forWhom.yes4: You want to set up your own development company and do it with a method.
forWhom.noTitle: It is not for you if…
forWhom.no1: You are after quick, risk-free money: development carries risks, and the course teaches you to measure them, not to make them vanish by magic.
forWhom.no2: You want protected housing: the course focuses on developing open-market housing.
